words.tr: phrase. 负面影响；产生不利影响；使恶化
words.ex: Smoking can negatively affect your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会损害你的肺部。
words.en: To have a harmful or adverse impact on something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 对……产生不利影响；负面影响
words.ex: Smoking can adversely influence your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟可能对你的健康产生不利影响。
words.en: Negatively affect or change something in an unfavorable way.

words.tr: phrase. 产生有害的影响；造成不利影响
words.ex: Smoking has a detrimental impact on your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的肺有害。
words.en: Cause a harmful or damaging effect on a person, situation, or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 学术表现；学业成绩
words.ex: His academic performance improved after he studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 他更努力学习后，学业表现提高了。
words.en: The achievement or success in academic studies or work, often measured by grades or other assessments.

words.tr: phrase. 学术成就；学业成绩
words.ex: He earned high academic achievement in math and science.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学和科学方面取得了优异的学业成绩。
words.en: Academic achievement refers to the level of schooling you have successfully completed and the ability to attain success in your studies.

words.tr: phrase. 研究结果；学习成果
words.ex: The study outcomes show better results for students who practice daily.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究结果表明，每天练习的学生表现更好。
words.en: The results or achievements obtained from academic or educational study.

words.tr: phrase. 学习成果；学习结果
words.ex: The learning results show improvement in math skills.
words.ex_cn: 学习成果显示数学技能有所提高。
words.en: The knowledge, skills, or understanding gained through learning processes.

words.tr: phrase. 为考试做准备；备考
words.ex: Students should prepare for exams early.
words.ex_cn: 学生应该尽早准备考试。
words.en: Get ready for formal assessments through study and practice.

words.tr: phrase. 为考试做准备
words.ex: He is getting ready for examinations this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周正在为考试做准备。
words.en: To prepare oneself for academic assessments through focused revision and practice.

words.tr: phrase. 为考试而学习
words.ex: He studies for tests every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上为考试学习。
words.en: To engage in systematic learning and review in order to perform well on assessments.

words.tr: phrase. 为考试而复习；备考
words.ex: He stays up late to revise for exams.
words.ex_cn: 他熬夜复习准备考试。
words.en: Review and consolidate knowledge in preparation for tests.

words.tr: phrase. 被……分散注意力的；因……而分心的
words.ex: He was distracted by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他被巨大的噪音分散了注意力。
words.en: Having one's attention diverted from a task or focus.

words.tr: phrase. 全神贯注于；一心想着；对…念念不忘
words.ex: He is preoccupied with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他全神贯注于他的作业。
words.en: If you are preoccupied with something, you are thinking about it a lot or worrying about it so that you do not pay attention to other things.

words.tr: phrase. 被……困扰的；因……而心烦意乱的
words.ex: He was disturbed by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他被那阵吵闹声打扰了。
words.en: Feeling emotionally or mentally unsettled or anxious due to a specific cause.

words.tr: phrase. 被……带偏；因……而分心
words.ex: He got sidetracked by his phone while doing homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在做作业时被手机分心了。
words.en: Distracted or diverted from one's main course of action or focus by an external factor.

words.tr: phrase. 婚姻责任；夫妻在婚姻关系中应承担的义务与职责
words.ex: He feels the marriage responsibilities every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都能感受到婚姻的责任。
words.en: The duties and obligations associated with being married.

words.tr: phrase. 婚姻义务；夫妻间的责任（尤指性义务）
words.ex: He forgot his marital duties and left his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记了婚姻的责任，离开了他的妻子。
words.en: The legal and social obligations expected between married partners.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭责任；家庭义务
words.ex: He couldn't join us for the trip because of his family obligations.
words.ex_cn: 他因为家庭义务不能和我们一起去旅行。
words.en: Duties or responsibilities that one has towards their family members.

words.tr: phrase. 配偶责任；夫妻间应尽的义务
words.ex: He accepts his spousal responsibilities with care.
words.ex_cn: 他认真履行自己的夫妻责任。
words.en: The duties and responsibilities owed by one spouse to another within a marriage.

words.tr: phrase. 导致成绩下降；造成分数降低
words.ex: Skipping class can lead to lower grades.
words.ex_cn: 逃课会导致成绩下降。
words.en: To cause a decline in academic performance or scores.

words.tr: phrase. 导致较差的成绩
words.ex: Skipping class can result in poorer marks.
words.ex_cn: 逃课会导致成绩更差。
words.en: To lead to or result in academic grades that are below one's potential or previous standards.

words.tr: phrase. 导致成绩/结果下降
words.ex: Too much screen time can cause a decline in results.
words.ex_cn: 过多的屏幕时间会导致成绩下降。
words.en: To cause a reduction or downward trend in the quality or level of academic performance.

words.tr: phrase. 导致分数降低；对较低的得分产生影响
words.ex: Poor sleep can contribute to lower scores on tests.
words.ex_cn: 睡眠不足会导致考试成绩下降。
words.en: To be a factor in the achievement of lower academic scores or grades.

words.tr: 获得一份稳定的工作
words.ex: He is obtaining a stable job after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后正在获得一份稳定的工作。
words.en: Securing a reliable and long-term position of employment.

words.w: securing stable employment gaining a steady occupation
words.tr: 获得稳定的工作；取得一份稳定的职位
words.uk: sɪˈkjʊərɪŋ ˈsteɪbl ɪmˈplɔɪmənt ˈɡeɪnɪŋ ə ˈstedi ˌɒkjuˈpeɪʃn
words.us: səˈkjʊrɪŋ ˈsteɪbəl ɪmˈplɔɪmənt ˈɡeɪnɪŋ ə ˈstɛdi ˌɑːkjuˈpeɪʃn
words.ex: He worked hard for years by securing stable employment.
words.ex_cn: 他经过多年努力获得了稳定的工作。
words.en: The process of obtaining a secure, long-term job or a reliable source of income.

words.tr: 实现工作稳定性；获得职业稳定
words.ex: He is achieving job stability by working hard and staying loyal to his company.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力工作并忠于公司来实现工作稳定。
words.en: Gaining long-term security in employment.

words.tr: phrase. 严重的财务压力
words.ex: He faces serious financial pressure because he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 他因为丢了工作而面临严重的经济压力。
words.en: A state of severe economic strain or difficulty, often involving limited resources and the risk of insolvency.

words.tr: phrase. 沉重的经济负担
words.ex: The family faces a heavy financial burden because of medical bills.
words.ex_cn: 由于医疗费用，这个家庭承受着沉重的经济负担。
words.en: A large and difficult-to-manage cost obligation.

words.tr: phrase. 严重的经济压力；严峻的经济困境
words.ex: The country faces severe economic stress after the war.
words.ex_cn: 战争之后，这个国家面临严重的经济压力。
words.en: Intense pressure on personal or national finances.

words.tr: phrase. 重大的经济压力；显著的财务负担
words.ex: The illness caused a significant monetary strain on the family.
words.ex_cn: 这场疾病给这个家庭带来了巨大的经济压力。
words.en: Substantial difficulty in managing money or resources.

words.tr: phrase. 支付租金
words.ex: He pays for rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月支付房租。
words.en: To give money in exchange for the use of a property, typically on a monthly basis.

words.tr: phrase. 生活费用；日常开销
words.ex: He works part-time to cover his living expenses.
words.ex_cn: 他做兼职来支付生活开销。
words.en: The costs incurred by a person or family for the necessities of life, such as food, shelter, and clothing.

words.tr: phrase. 支付住房与学费
words.ex: He works part-time to cover housing and tuition.
words.ex_cn: 他兼职工作以支付住宿和学费。
words.en: Pay for accommodation and educational fees.

words.tr: phrase. 日常开支；每日费用
words.ex: The daily costs of running the shop are high.
words.ex_cn: 经营商店的每日开销很高。
words.en: The regular expenses incurred each day, such as food, transport, and utilities.

words.tr: phrase. 学费
words.ex: He paid the school fees with his savings.
words.ex_cn: 他用储蓄支付了学费。
words.en: The amount of money that is charged for teaching by a school, especially a private one.

words.tr: phrase. 可靠的收入来源
words.ex: He has a reliable source of income from his part-time job.
words.ex_cn: 他有一份来自兼职工作的稳定收入来源。
words.en: reliable source of income: a steady and dependable way of earning money.

words.tr: phrase. 稳定的财务支持和持续的收益
words.ex: He has stable financial support and consistent earnings from his job.
words.ex_cn: 他有稳定的经济支持和持续的收入来自他的工作。
words.en: Reliable income that provides steady financial security.

words.tr: n. 正式考试
words.ex: He will take a formal exam next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将参加一次正式考试。
words.en: A structured assessment, typically written or oral, conducted under controlled conditions to evaluate a candidate's knowledge or skills, often for certification or academic purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 笔试；书面考试
words.ex: He passed the written test with high marks.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了笔试。
words.en: A written test is an examination where the answers must be written, typically to assess knowledge or proficiency in a particular subject.

words.tr: n. 笔试；纸质考试
words.ex: He took a paper exam last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周参加了一次纸质考试。
words.en: A written test taken on paper, as opposed to a digital or oral examination.

words.tr: n. 有效方法；有效手段
words.ex: This is a valid method to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种解决这个问题的有效方法。
words.en: A procedure or technique that is accepted as correct and effective for achieving a particular result.

words.tr: phrase. 有效的方法；行之有效的方式
words.ex: This is an effective way to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种学习英语的有效方法。
words.en: A method or approach that achieves the desired result efficiently.

words.tr: n. 合理的方法；稳妥的策略
words.ex: He uses a sound approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种合理的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A method or strategy that is based on solid reasoning, evidence, and good judgment, leading to reliable and effective results.

words.tr: v. 评估学习（成果或过程）
words.ex: The teacher will assess learning at the end of the week.
words.ex_cn: 老师将在周末评估学习情况。
words.en: Evaluate a student's progress, understanding, or skills in an educational context, often through tests, assignments, or observations.

words.tr: v. 衡量进展；评估进步
words.ex: We measure progress by checking test scores each month.
words.ex_cn: 我们通过每月检查考试成绩来衡量进步。
words.en: To assess the rate or extent of development or improvement towards a goal.

words.tr: n. 测试能力；测验能力
words.ex: The test ability of the new device is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个新设备的测试能力很强。
words.en: A formal or informal assessment of someone's skills, knowledge, or performance in a specific area.

words.tr: n. 真实能力；真正的才能
words.ex: He showed his true ability in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上展现了真正的才能。
words.en: The genuine capacity to do something effectively.

words.tr: n. 真正的技能；实际的本领
words.ex: He has real skill in playing the guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他弹吉他有真正的本事。
words.en: Genuine proficiency or talent in a particular area.

words.tr: n. 实际水平；实际层级
words.ex: The actual level of water is lower than expected.
words.ex_cn: 水的实际水平比预期的低。
words.en: The current degree of competence or achievement.

words.tr: adj. 公平公正的；正直合理的
words.ex: The judge made a fair and just decision.
words.ex_cn: 法官做出了公平且公正的决定。
words.en: Treating people or situations without bias or favoritism.

words.tr: adj. 平等且开放的
words.ex: The school has an equal and open policy for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校对所有学生都有平等且开放的政策。
words.en: Impartial and transparent in approach or treatment.

words.tr: adj. 客观且清晰的
words.ex: Her explanation is objective and clear.
words.ex_cn: 她的解释客观且清晰。
words.en: Unbiased and easy to understand.

words.tr: n. 相同的条件
words.ex: The plants grow under the same conditions.
words.ex_cn: 这些植物在相同的条件下生长。
words.en: Circumstances that are the same for all participants.

words.tr: n. 相等的设定；均等的配置
words.ex: The game has an equal setting for all players.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏为所有玩家设置了相等的条件。
words.en: A situation where everyone has the same opportunities.

words.tr: n. 完全相同的案例；完全一致的情况
words.ex: The two lawsuits are an identical case.
words.ex_cn: 这两起诉讼是完全相同的案例。
words.en: A scenario that is exactly the same in all relevant aspects.

words.tr: n. 评分规则；批改规则；标记规则
words.ex: The teacher explained the marking rules clearly.
words.ex_cn: 老师清楚地解释了评分规则。
words.en: The standards used for assessing and assigning grades.

words.tr: n. 评分标准；评级标准
words.ex: The teacher changed the grading standards for the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师改变了这次考试的评分标准。
words.en: A set of criteria used to assess and assign scores to academic work.

words.tr: phrase. 得分指南；计分指导手册
words.ex: The score guide shows how points are given for each answer.
words.ex_cn: 评分指南显示每个答案的得分方式。
words.en: A set of standards or criteria used to evaluate and score a piece of work.

words.tr: v. 保持公平；维持公正
words.ex: The teacher keeps fairness in grading all students.
words.ex_cn: 老师在给所有学生评分时保持公平。
words.en: To maintain impartiality and avoid bias in decision-making or treatment.

words.tr: v. 确保公正；保障正义
words.ex: The judge works to ensure justice for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 法官努力为每个人确保正义。
words.en: To guarantee that outcomes are fair and morally right according to established principles.

words.tr: v. 保持平等；维持相等
words.ex: The two sides must stay equal.
words.ex_cn: 两边必须保持相等。
words.en: To remain in a state of balance or equivalence, without favoring one side.

words.tr: v. 理解文本；读懂文字内容
words.ex: I can understand text easily.
words.ex_cn: 我很容易理解文字。
words.en: To comprehend the meaning and implications of written or spoken language.

words.tr: v. 理解内容；掌握内容
words.ex: He cannot grasp the content of the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解这节课的内容。
words.en: To understand the main ideas and details of a piece of information or communication.

words.tr: n. 学习材料；教学资料
words.ex: The teacher gave us new learn material for the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们发了新的学习材料来准备考试。
words.en: To acquire knowledge or skills through study, experience, or instruction.

words.tr: v. 完成考试
words.ex: He will finish exam tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会完成考试。
words.en: To bring an examination to a conclusion, submitting all required answers.

words.tr: n. 完整测试；全面测试
words.ex: The student finished the complete test before the bell rang.
words.ex_cn: 学生在铃响前完成了完整测试。
words.en: To finish all sections of a test within the allotted time.

words.tr: n. 答题纸；答卷
words.ex: He handed in his answer paper before the bell rang.
words.ex_cn: 他在铃响前交了答卷。
words.en: The written responses submitted by a candidate during an examination.

words.tr: phrase. 有限的时间；时限
words.ex: The sale is for a limited time only.
words.ex_cn: 这次促销只有有限的时间。
words.en: A period of time that is not long or is restricted in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 设定的时间；约定的时间
words.ex: We set time for the meeting at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们把会议时间定在下午3点。
words.en: To arrange or fix a specific time for an event or action.

words.tr: phrase. 特定时期的；给定时间段的
words.ex: He worked during the given period.
words.ex_cn: 他在指定的时期内工作了。
words.en: A specific or designated length of time.

words.tr: n. 实际水平；真实程度
words.ex: His real level in math is higher than he thinks.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学实际水平比他想的要高。
words.en: The actual degree or extent of something, especially in terms of quality, quantity, or achievement, as opposed to an apparent or estimated level.

words.tr: n. 真正的理解；准确的掌握
words.ex: He has a true grasp of basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他对基础数学有真正的理解。
words.en: A thorough and accurate understanding of a concept or situation, often implying the ability to apply it effectively.

words.tr: n. 实际意义；真实含义
words.ex: He doesn't understand the actual sense of the word.
words.ex_cn: 他不明白这个词的实际含义。
words.en: The true meaning or significance of a word or phrase, as opposed to its literal or figurative interpretation.

words.tr: v. 核对结果；检查结果
words.ex: Please check results before submitting the form.
words.ex_cn: 请在提交表格前核对结果。
words.en: The outcome or findings from an examination, test, or investigation.

words.tr: v. 评估结果；评定成果
words.ex: The teacher will assess the outcome of the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师将评估这次考试的结果。
words.en: Evaluate the result or consequence of an action, process, or decision.

words.tr: v. 衡量收益；测量获得的成果

words.ex_cn: 公司每个季度衡量其新产品带来的收益。
words.en: To assess and quantify improvements or benefits achieved, especially in business or personal development contexts.

words.tr: n. 明确的措施；清晰的衡量标准
words.ex: The government took a clear measure to stop pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府采取了明确的措施来防止污染。
words.en: A clear and unambiguous way of expressing or measuring something; a definitive standard or method.

words.tr: n. 精确数字；准确数值
words.ex: He gave the exact number of students in the class.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了班级里学生的准确人数。
words.en: A precise and specific quantity, not an estimate or approximation.

words.tr: n. 平面图形；简单图形
words.ex: The child drew a plain figure with three sides.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一个有三条边的平面图形。
words.en: A simple, unadorned shape or outline, often used in design or geometry to refer to a basic form without decorative elements.

words.tr: n. 扎实的知识；深厚的知识

words.ex_cn: 他数学知识很扎实。
words.en: A deep and comprehensive understanding of a subject or field, often gained through extensive study or experience.

words.tr: n. 深度学习（一种基于人工神经网络的机器学习方法）
words.ex: He is learning deep learning from online videos.
words.ex_cn: 他正在通过在线视频学习深度学习。
words.en: A branch of machine learning that uses neural networks with multiple layers to learn complex patterns from large datasets.

words.tr: n. 扎实的技能；过硬的本领
words.ex: He has a solid skill in writing essays.
words.ex_cn: 他具有扎实的写作文章技能。
words.en: A practical and reliable ability that is developed through experience and is not easily shaken.

words.tr: n. 实际性能；真实表现
words.ex: His real performance surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的真实表现让所有人感到惊讶。
words.en: The actual level of achievement or execution in a specific task or activity, as opposed to theoretical or expected performance.

words.tr: n. 真实结果；准确结果
words.ex: The calculation gives a true result.
words.ex_cn: 这个计算得出一个正确的结果。
words.en: The actual outcome or conclusion that is accurate and correct, often used in contexts like testing or decision-making.

words.tr: n. 实际输出；实际产出
words.ex: The actual output is 15.
words.ex_cn: 实际输出是15。
words.en: The real or true result, performance, or product of something, especially in contrast to what was expected or intended.

words.tr: adj. 可测量的分数；可量化的得分
words.ex: The test provides measurable scores for each student.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试为每个学生提供可测量的分数。
words.en: Quantifiable results or metrics that can be objectively measured and compared, typically used in educational or performance assessments.

words.tr: n. 清晰的标记；明显的痕迹
words.ex: He left clear marks on the whiteboard.
words.ex_cn: 他在白板上留下了清晰的痕迹。
words.en: Distinct, visible signs or indicators that are easy to see and understand.

words.tr: n. 数字成绩；用数字表示的评分
words.ex: The teacher gives numeric grades for each test.
words.ex_cn: 老师为每次考试给出数值成绩。
words.en: A system of evaluating academic performance using numbers, such as 1 to 10 or A to F, to represent a student's achievement level.

words.tr: 政府拥有权威（或权力）

words.ex_cn: 政府有权力制定法律。
words.en: The power or right to give orders, make decisions, and enforce obedience within a particular domain, typically held by a governing body.

words.tr: 政府拥有权力
words.ex: Governments have power to make laws.
words.ex_cn: 政府有权制定法律。
words.en: The authority or control that a government has over its people and territory.

words.tr: 政府负责；政府掌管
words.ex: Governments are in charge of schools and hospitals.
words.ex_cn: 政府负责学校和医院。

words.tr: v. 引起混乱；造成困惑

words.en: To cause uncertainty or lack of clarity in someone's mind.

words.tr: v. 引起误会；造成误解

words.tr: v. 导致混乱；引起无序
words.ex: Poor planning can lead to disorder.
words.ex_cn: 计划不周可能导致混乱。
words.en: To result in a state of confusion, chaos, or lack of order.

words.tr: v. 降低质量
words.ex: The cheap material reduces the quality of the product.
words.ex_cn: 廉价材料降低了产品的质量。
words.en: To make something of lower quality or value.

words.tr: v. 降低标准
words.ex: The school lowered the standard to let more students pass.
words.ex_cn: 学校降低了标准，让更多的学生通过。
words.en: To cause a decline in the level of excellence or achievement.

words.tr: v. 削弱结果；使结果变弱
words.ex: The noise can weaken the result of the test.
words.ex_cn: 噪音可能会削弱测试的结果。
words.en: Make the outcome less effective or strong.

words.tr: n. 最终决定；最后的裁决
words.ex: The manager made the final decisions yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 经理昨天做出了最终决定。
words.en: Conclusive judgments or choices made after consideration.

words.tr: n. 最终结果；最终成果
words.ex: The end results of the test were surprising.
words.ex_cn: 测试的最终结果令人惊讶。
words.en: Ultimate outcomes or consequences of a process.

words.tr: phrase. 最终选择
words.ex: These are the ultimate choices for your future.
words.ex_cn: 这些是你未来的最终选择。
words.en: The final or most important decisions or options available to someone, often after considering all alternatives.

words.tr: n. 建筑设计；建筑物的设计
words.ex: He works on the design of buildings.
words.ex_cn: 他从事建筑物的设计工作。
words.en: The planning and creation of structures for human use.

words.tr: n. 建筑布局；建筑物的平面布置
words.ex: The architect showed us the building layout.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师给我们展示了建筑布局。
words.en: The arrangement and organization of spaces within a structure.

words.tr: n. 建筑设计；建筑规划
words.ex: He loves architectural design because it is creative.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢建筑设计，因为它富有创造力。
words.en: The art and science of designing buildings and other physical structures.

words.tr: n. 设计精良的建筑
words.ex: The well-designed building has big windows and clean lines.
words.ex_cn: 这座设计良好的建筑有大窗户和简洁的线条。
words.en: A building created with careful thought to function and aesthetics.

words.tr: 良好的设计
words.ex: The chair has good design.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子设计很好。
words.en: The quality of being well-conceived, functional, and aesthetically pleasing.

words.tr: n. 智能建筑；指融合了先进技术（如物联网、自动化系统等）以提高能效、舒适性和安全性的建筑设计与结构
words.ex: The building has smart architecture that saves energy.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑具有节能的智能设计。
words.en: Intelligent or innovative architectural solutions that optimize use.

words.tr: v. 提高工作效率，提升生产力
words.ex: She uses a timer to enhance work efficiency and improve productivity.
words.ex_cn: 她使用计时器来提高工作效率和生产力。
words.en: Boost the effectiveness and output of work activities.

words.tr: phrase. 提升性能；增强表现
words.ex: Regular updates can boost performance of your device.
words.ex_cn: 定期更新可以提高您设备的性能。
words.en: To boost performance means to improve the efficiency or speed of a system, device, or process.

words.tr: n. 安全且封闭的空间
words.ex: The child plays in a safe and enclosed space.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在一个安全且封闭的空间里玩耍。
words.en: A secure, sheltered, and confined area.

words.tr: n. 安全房间；保密室（指经过特殊防护、用于保护敏感信息或设备的房间）

words.ex_cn: 钥匙存放在一个安全的房间里。
words.en: A room with controlled access for security purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 私人区域；私密空间；私处
words.ex: This is a private area; no entry allowed.
words.ex_cn: 这是私人区域，禁止入内。
words.en: An area that is not accessible to the general public.

words.tr: n. 开放式办公室（指没有隔断或独立房间的办公空间）
words.ex: Many companies use open offices to save space.
words.ex_cn: 许多公司使用开放式办公室来节省空间。
words.en: Work environments without physical partitions between desks.

words.tr: n. 共享办公空间；共享工作区（指多人共同使用的办公环境或区域）
words.ex: They use shared workspaces to work together.
words.ex_cn: 他们使用共享工作空间一起工作。
words.en: Spaces where multiple employees share a common area for work.

words.tr: n. 开放式布局区域；指没有隔断墙、空间通透的办公或生活区域
words.ex: The office has an open-plan area for all employees.
words.ex_cn: 办公室有一个开放式的区域供所有员工使用。
words.en: An office layout with few or no walls between workstations.

words.tr: phrase. 引起分心；造成干扰
words.ex: Loud music can cause distractions while studying.
words.ex_cn: 大声的音乐在学习时会引起分心。
words.en: To cause someone to stop paying attention to something by making them look at or listen to something else.

words.tr: v. 制造干扰；引起中断
words.ex: He creates interruptions during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议中制造干扰。
words.en: To cause disruptions that break concentration or workflow.

words.tr: v. 导致干扰；引起扰乱
words.ex: Loud music can lead to disturbance in the neighborhood.
words.ex_cn: 大声的音乐会导致邻居的干扰。
words.en: To result in disruptive or distracting conditions.

words.tr: n. 背景噪音；环境杂音
words.ex: The background noise made it hard to hear the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 背景噪音让她很难听清老师的话。
words.en: Ambient sound that can interfere with focus or communication.

words.tr: n. 设计拙劣的办公室
words.ex: The workers are tired because of the poorly designed offices.
words.ex_cn: 工人们因为设计糟糕的办公室而感到疲惫。
words.en: Office layouts that fail to meet functional or ergonomic needs.

words.tr: n. 规划不善的工作场所，不舒适的办公室
words.ex: The badly planned workplaces have uncomfortable offices.
words.ex_cn: 布局糟糕的工作场所拥有不舒适的办公室。
words.en: Workplaces that are uncomfortable due to ineffective planning.

words.tr: n. 不良的建筑设计；拙劣的建筑规划
words.ex: The poor building design causes cold rooms in winter.
words.ex_cn: 糟糕的建筑设计导致冬天房间很冷。
words.en: Architectural flaws that negatively impact the usability of a building.

words.tr: n. 糟糕的建筑（设计）；不良的建筑结构
words.ex: The building has bad architecture and leaks when it rains.
words.ex_cn: 这栋建筑的结构很差，下雨时会漏水。
words.en: A building or structure with poor planning, inefficient use of space, or unsightly appearance.

words.tr: n. 有缺陷的设计
words.ex: The bridge collapsed because of its flawed design.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥因设计缺陷而坍塌。
words.en: A plan or product with inherent defects or weaknesses that affect its functionality or appeal.

words.tr: phrase. 负面影响；不良后果
words.ex: Smoking has negative effects on your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有负面影响。
words.en: Adverse or harmful consequences resulting from a particular action or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 有害的影响；造成损害的作用
words.ex: Smoking has a harmful impact on your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的肺有有害影响。
words.en: A harmful impact refers to the negative effect or influence that something has on a person, thing, or situation.

words.tr: n. 坏影响；不良影响
words.ex: He fell into bad influence from his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他受到了朋友的不良影响。
words.en: A person or thing that encourages negative or harmful behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 身体与心理健康；指生理和心理两方面的健康状态
words.ex: Eating well and sleeping enough help physical and mental health.
words.ex_cn: 吃得好和睡得足够有助于身心健康。
words.en: The state of being healthy in both body and mind, encompassing physical fitness and mental well-being.

words.tr: n. 拥挤不堪的公寓；塞满人的单元房
words.ex: Many families live in overcrowded apartments packed with flats.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭住在拥挤的公寓里，里面挤满了小房间。
words.en: Living spaces filled with too many people, causing discomfort and lack of privacy.

words.tr: n. 拥挤的住房；指居住空间狭小、住户过多的住房状况
words.ex: Many families live in crowded housing in the city.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭住在城市里的拥挤住房里。
words.en: Residential areas with an excessive number of inhabitants relative to available space.

words.tr: n. 空气流通不良；通风不畅
words.ex: The room has poor air circulation.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间空气流通不好。
words.en: Inadequate movement of air within a space, leading to stuffiness and potential health risks.

words.tr: n. 通风不良
words.ex: The room has bad ventilation and feels stuffy.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间通风不良，感觉闷热。
words.en: A system or condition of air exchange that is insufficient, causing poor indoor air quality.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吸系统疾病
words.ex: He has respiratory diseases because he smokes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吸烟而患有呼吸系统疾病。
words.en: Illnesses affecting the lungs and breathing system.

words.tr: phrase. 肺部问题；肺病
words.ex: He has lung problems from smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吸烟有肺部问题。
words.en: Issues or diseases affecting the lungs, which are essential for breathing.

words.tr: n. 呼吸问题；呼吸困难
words.ex: He has breathing issues when he runs.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步时有呼吸问题。
words.en: Medical conditions or symptoms resulting from or aggravated by breathing polluted or stale air.

words.tr: phrase. 自然元素；天然要素
words.ex: The painting uses natural elements like trees and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画使用了树木和河流等自然元素。
words.en: The basic substances that occur naturally in the environment and are not made by humans, such as air, water, and soil.

words.tr: n. 绿色特性；环保功能（指产品、建筑或系统中具有节能环保、可持续发展等特性的设计或功能）
words.ex: The house has green features like solar panels.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有太阳能电池板等绿色功能。
words.en: Design elements in a building or product that are environmentally friendly or sustainable.

words.tr: n. 绿色植物（指含有叶绿素、能进行光合作用的植物）
words.ex: Green plants make food from sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 绿色植物通过阳光制造食物。
words.en: Vegetation grown indoors or in urban settings for aesthetic, air-purifying, or psychological benefits.

words.tr: phrase. 室内植物；适合在室内栽培的观赏植物
words.ex: She buys indoor plants for her living room.
words.ex_cn: 她为客厅买了室内植物。
words.en: Plants grown or kept inside buildings for decoration or air quality.

words.tr: n. 绿色植物；
words.ex: The park is full of greenery.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园里到处都是绿色植物。
words.en: Plants and foliage, especially when used for decoration.

words.tr: phrase. 心理健康：指一个人的心理状态良好，能够积极应对生活中的压力和挑战。
words.ex: Exercise helps improve mental well-being.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有助于改善心理健康。
words.en: The state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy.

words.tr: phrase. 情绪健康；心理健康；指个体在情感和心理层面的良好状态
words.ex: Maintaining emotional health is as important as physical health.
words.ex_cn: 保持情绪健康与保持身体健康同样重要。
words.en: Emotional health refers to the state of one's psychological and emotional well-being, where an individual can manage their feelings and cope with the stresses of life.

words.tr: phrase. 心理状态；精神状态
words.ex: His mental state improved after rest.
words.ex_cn: 他休息后精神状态好转了。
words.en: A person's mental state refers to their psychological condition at a particular time, including their thoughts, feelings, and emotions.

words.tr: phrase. 减少压力
words.ex: Yoga helps her reduce stress.
words.ex_cn: 瑜伽帮助她减轻压力。
words.en: To lessen or alleviate stress.

words.tr: phrase. 缓解紧张；减轻压力
words.ex: She sings to ease tension after work.
words.ex_cn: 她唱歌来缓解工作后的紧张。
words.en: Reduce feelings of hostility or nervousness between people or in a situation.

words.tr: v. 降低焦虑；减轻焦虑感
words.ex: She listens to music to lower anxiety.
words.ex_cn: 她听音乐来减轻焦虑。
words.en: A reduction in feelings of stress, worry, or nervousness, often achieved through environmental or lifestyle changes.

words.tr: v. 促进放松；有助于放松身心
words.ex: Yoga helps to promote relaxation.
words.ex_cn: 瑜伽有助于促进放松。
words.en: To encourage a state of calm and reduce stress.

words.tr: v. 鼓励保持冷静；促进平静
words.ex: The teacher encourages calmness during tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试时鼓励保持冷静。
words.en: To promote a state of peace and composure.

words.tr: v. 帮助放松；帮助缓解压力
words.ex: He listens to music to help unwind after work.
words.ex_cn: 他听音乐来帮助放松一下。
words.en: To assist in relaxing and reducing stress.

words.tr: n. 宝贵的财富；珍贵的宝物
words.ex: They found valuable treasures in the old cave.
words.ex_cn: 他们在旧洞穴里发现了珍贵的宝藏。
words.en: Objects of significant worth, often historical or cultural, that are highly prized.

words.tr: n. 文化资产；文化遗产
words.ex: The museum protects cultural assets from old times.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆保护来自古代的文化遗产。
words.en: Cultural resources, such as monuments or traditions, that are important to a community's identity.

words.tr: phrase. 历史的象征；代表历史的事物或标志

words.ex_cn: 自由女神像是最为人所知的历史象征之一。
words.en: Visual representations that embody historical events, cultures, or eras, often used for education or commemoration.

words.w: culture signs of civilisation marks of tradition

words.uk: ˈkʌltʃə saɪnz əv ˌsɪvəlaɪˈzeɪʃn mɑːks əv trəˈdɪʃn

words.en: Symbols or features that represent the development and traditions of a civilization.

words.w: protect historical buildings preserve old structures safeguard heritage sites

words.us: prəˈtekt hɪˈstɔːrɪkl ˈbɪldɪŋz, prɪˈzɜːrv oʊld ˈstrʌktʃərz, ˈseɪfɡɑːrd ˈherɪtɪdʒ saɪts

words.tr: phrase. 自然灾害；天灾
words.ex: Natural disasters can destroy homes and villages.

words.en: Natural disasters are major adverse events resulting from natural processes of the Earth; examples include floods, hurricanes, tornadoes, volcanic eruptions, earthquakes, tsunamis, and other geologic processes.

words.tr: phrase. 自然灾害；自然风险；天然危险
words.ex: Earthquakes and floods are natural hazards.
words.ex_cn: 地震和洪水是自然灾害。
words.en: Natural hazards are natural phenomena that might have a negative effect on humans or the environment. These phenomena can include earthquakes, floods, hurricanes, and other events that are beyond human control.

words.tr: n. 环境灾难；生态灾难
words.ex: The storm caused environmental catastrophes in the coastal areas.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴在沿海地区造成了环境灾难。
words.en: Large-scale, severe events that cause extensive damage to the natural environment.

words.tr: n. 洪水和地震
words.ex: The flood and earthquakes destroyed the village.
words.ex_cn: 洪水和地震摧毁了村庄。
words.en: A combination of natural disasters causing widespread destruction and loss.

words.tr: n. 暴风雨；雷暴雨；
words.ex: The storm broke out at night.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨在夜间爆发了。
words.en: A storm is very bad weather, with heavy rain, strong winds, and often thunder and lightning.

words.tr: n.洪水
words.ex: The rains caused floods in the village.
words.ex_cn: 雨水引发了村庄的洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide. Flooding may occur as an overflow of water from water bodies, such as a river or lake, in which the water overtops or breaks levees, resulting in some of that water escaping its usual boundaries, or it may occur due to an accumulation of rainwater on saturated ground in an areal flood.

words.w: cannot be recovered impossible lost forever
words.tr: adj. 无法恢复的；不可能的；永远失去的
words.uk: ˌkænɒt bi rɪˈkʌvəd, ɪmˈpɒsəbl, lɒst fəˈrevə
words.us: ˌkænɑːt bi rɪˈkʌvərd, ɪmˈpɑːsəbl, lɔːst fəˈrevər
words.ex: The data cannot be recovered; it is lost forever.
words.ex_cn: 数据无法恢复；它永远丢失了。
words.en: So severely damaged or destroyed that it is impossible to restore or retrieve.

words.tr: n. 巨大的损失
words.ex: The company had a huge loss last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年遭受了巨大损失。
words.en: A very large amount of something lost, especially valuable resources or assets.

words.tr: n. 巨大的损害；严重的破坏
words.ex: The storm caused great damage to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重破坏。
words.en: Significant harm or impairment to the structure, function, or value of something.

words.tr: phrase. 人类文明；人类社会在文化、科技、政治和艺术等方面的发展成果
words.ex: Human civilisation began with farming and villages.
words.ex_cn: 人类文明始于农业和村庄。
words.en: The complex social and cultural developments of human beings over time.

words.tr: phrase. 人类文化；指人类社会所创造的信仰、习俗、艺术、制度等的总和
words.ex: The study of human culture helps us understand the diversity of human societies.
words.ex_cn: 对人类文化的研究帮助我们理解人类社会的多样性。
words.en: The customs, arts, social institutions, and achievements of human beings collectively.

words.tr: n. 保护不足；防护不充分
words.ex: The helmet offers insufficient protection in a crash.
words.ex_cn: 这个头盔在碰撞中提供的保护不够。
words.en: A lack of adequate safeguards or measures to prevent harm or damage.

words.tr: n. 保存状况差；不良的保存
words.ex: The old book has poor preservation because of damp weather.
words.ex_cn: 由于潮湿的天气，这本旧书保存得很差。
words.en: The poor state of being kept in good condition, leading to deterioration.

words.tr: n. 薄弱的维护；不足的保养
words.ex: The building has weak maintenance and many pipes are broken.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑维护很差，许多管道都坏了。
words.en: The practice of maintaining something in a weak or ineffective manner.

words.tr: n. 教育价值观；教育理念中所重视的基本原则或信念
words.ex: Parents teach children educational values at home.
words.ex_cn: 父母在家中教导孩子教育价值观。
words.en: Principles or standards regarded as important for learning and development.

words.tr: phrase. 学习益处；学习带来的好处
words.ex: The learning benefits are clear for students who practice daily.
words.ex_cn: 每天练习的学生学习收益很明显。
words.en: The advantages or positive outcomes gained from the process of acquiring knowledge.

words.tr: n. 精致的建筑风格
words.ex: The building has a delicate architectural style.
words.ex_cn: 这栋建筑有一种精致的建筑风格。
words.en: An architectural style characterized by intricate details, fragility, and elegance.

words.tr: n. 精致的设计；精美的设计
words.ex: The vase has a fine design.
words.ex_cn: 这个花瓶有一个精美的设计。
words.en: A design that is of high quality, showing great skill and attention to detail.

words.tr: n. 艺术结构；指作品在艺术表现上的组织与构成方式
words.ex: The building has an artistic structure.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑具有艺术性的结构。
words.en: The deliberate arrangement of elements in a work of art to create a unified and meaningful composition.

words.tr: phrase. 旧建筑；老楼房；古老建筑物
words.ex: The city is famous for its old buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市以其古老的建筑而闻名。
words.en: Buildings that have existed for a long time and are often considered historical or of significant cultural value.

words.tr: n. 历史建筑；具有历史意义的房屋
words.ex: They visited historic houses in the old town.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了老城区的历史建筑。
words.en: Buildings of historical significance that are preserved for their architectural, cultural, or social value.

words.tr: phrase. 古迹，遗址
words.ex: Tourists visit ancient sites to see old temples.
words.ex_cn: 游客参观古代遗址去看古老的寺庙。
words.en: Places of historical interest or archaeological significance, often ruins or remains from past civilizations.

words.tr: 短语。指某事物在书中找不到，常用来形容某种知识、经验或智慧无法从书本中获得，而需通过实践或其他途径获取。
words.ex: The answer is not found in books.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案在书里找不到。
words.en: Information or knowledge that is not documented or available in written texts.

words.tr: adj. 缺席课堂教学的；未参与课堂学习的
words.ex: He is absent from classroom learning because he is sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病而缺席课堂学习。
words.en: Learning that does not occur through formal instruction in an educational institution.

words.tr: n. 现实生活中的经历；真实生活体验
words.ex: He learned from real-life experiences.
words.ex_cn: 他从真实的生活经历中学习。
words.en: Direct participation in events or activities, providing practical knowledge beyond theory.

words.tr: phrase. 实践性学习；通过实际操作获得知识或技能的学习方式
words.ex: Students enjoy practical learning in science class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们喜欢在科学课上进行实践学习。
words.en: Learning that involves hands-on experience, application of skills, and direct engagement with real-world tasks.

words.tr: n. 动手实践的理解；亲身操作所获得的理解
words.ex: He gained hands-on understanding by fixing the machine himself.
words.ex_cn: 他通过亲自修理机器获得了实际理解。
words.en: Knowledge gained through practical, direct involvement rather than theoretical study.

words.tr: v. 扣除学生的分数
words.ex: The teacher deducts students' marks for late homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师因作业迟交而扣学生的分数。
words.en: To subtract points from a student's work as a penalty for errors or late submission.

words.tr: v. 降低成绩；减少评分
words.ex: The teacher will reduce grades for late homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师会因为迟交作业而降低分数。
words.en: To lower the numerical value assigned to a student's work, often as a form of assessment.

words.tr: n. 划分分数线；临界分数（用于决定通过或失败、等级划分等的分数标准）
words.ex: The teacher will cut scores to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师会降低及格分数。
words.en: To reduce the score or mark given to a piece of work, typically to reflect poor performance.

words.tr: n. 迟交的作业／迟交的提交
words.ex: The teacher does not accept assignments given late.
words.ex_cn: 老师不接受迟交的作业。
words.en: Academic tasks that are submitted after the specified deadline, often resulting in penalties.

words.tr: n. 延迟的任务；被推迟的工作事项
words.ex: He forgot the delayed tasks on his list.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记了清单上推迟的任务。
words.en: Tasks that are postponed or completed after their scheduled time.

words.tr: v. 确保公平；保证公正
words.ex: The rules ensures fairness in the game.
words.ex_cn: 这些规则确保了比赛的公平性。
words.en: Guarantees impartial and just treatment for all involved parties.

words.tr: v. 维持平等；保持公平
words.ex: She adds 5 to both sides to maintains equality.
words.ex_cn: 她两边都加5以保持相等。
words.en: Preserves a state of equal rights, opportunities, or treatment.

words.tr: v. 维持正义；主持公道
words.ex: He keeps justice by treating everyone fairly.
words.ex_cn: 他通过公平对待每个人来维护正义。
words.en: Upholds or administers what is morally right and just.

words.tr: v. 迟交；逾期提交
words.ex: He submits his homework late every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五都迟交作业。
words.en: To present work or a submission after the required deadline.

words.tr: phr. 迟交（作业、报告等）
words.ex: He handed in his homework late.
words.ex_cn: 他迟交了作业。
words.en: To give or send in work after the specified time has passed.

words.tr: v. 迟交；晚归（如作业、报告等）
words.ex: He turned in his homework late.
words.ex_cn: 他迟交了作业。
words.en: To submit or deliver work past the due date.

words.tr: v. 改进他们的工作；使他们的工作更加精细或完善
words.ex: He will refine their work before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他会在截止日期前改进他们的作品。
words.en: To make improvements to a piece of work, enhancing its quality.

words.tr: v. 改进他们的任务；提升他们的工作成效
words.ex: They try to improve their tasks every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天努力改进自己的任务。
words.en: To enhance or make better the quality or effectiveness of assigned tasks.

words.tr: v. 润色他们的作品；改进他们的工作
words.ex: He will polish their work before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他会在截止日期前润色他们的作品。
words.en: To refine and perfect a piece of work to a high standard.

words.tr: adj. 对学生不公平的
words.ex: This test is unfair to students who did not study enough.
words.ex_cn: 对于没有充分学习的学生来说，这次考试是不公平的。
words.en: Treating students in a way that is unjust or biased.

words.tr: adj. 对同学不公平的；对同班同学不公正的
words.ex: It is inequitable to classmates to cheat on the test.
words.ex_cn: 考试作弊对同学来说是不公平的。
words.en: Unjust or discriminatory towards fellow students.

words.tr: adj. 对同龄人（或同事）不公平的
words.ex: It is not fair to peers to cheat on the test.
words.ex_cn: 考试作弊对同学是不公平的。
words.en: Not just or impartial in relation to one's companions.

words.w: on time before the deadline punctually
words.tr: adv. 准时地；在截止时间之前；按时
words.uk: ɒn taɪm, bɪˈfɔː ðə ˈdedlaɪn, ˈpʌŋktʃuəli
words.us: ɑːn taɪm, bɪˈfɔːr ðə ˈdedlaɪn, ˈpʌŋktʃuəli
words.ex: He arrives on time before the deadline punctually.
words.ex_cn: 他总是在截止日期前准时到达。
words.en: Arriving or completing tasks before the final due date in a timely manner.

words.tr: n. 迟交罚金；逾期罚款
words.ex: He paid the late penalties for his overdue book.
words.ex_cn: 他为那本过期的书支付了迟交罚款。
words.en: Penalties imposed for submitting work after the required time.

words.tr: n. 提交罚款；提交的罚金
words.ex: He paid the submission fines last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周交了提交罚款。
words.en: Fees charged for late submission of assignments or tasks.

words.tr: n. 扣分；分数扣除
words.ex: The teacher marked deductions for wrong answers.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为错误的答案扣了分。
words.en: Reductions in scores or grades for various reasons.

words.tr: n. 时间管理技能与规划能力
words.ex: He has good time management skills and strong planning ability.
words.ex_cn: 他有良好的时间管理技能和很强的规划能力。
words.en: The ability to effectively organize and allocate time for tasks and goals.

words.tr: 组织能力
words.ex: He has strong organisational skills.
words.ex_cn: 他有很强的组织能力。
words.en: Organisational skills refer to the ability to use your time, energy, resources, etc. in an effective way so that you achieve the things you want to achieve.

words.tr: phrase. 未来的职业；今后的职业发展方向
words.ex: He is thinking about his future careers.
words.ex_cn: 他正在考虑自己未来的职业。
words.en: Professions or occupations that individuals may pursue in later life.

words.tr: phrase. 职业道路；事业发展路径
words.ex: He explored many career paths before choosing teaching.
words.ex_cn: 他在选择教书之前探索了许多职业道路。
words.en: Career paths refer to the sequence of jobs that a person holds during their working life, often within a particular field or profession.

words.tr: phrase. 职业生涯；工作年限；一个人从事工作的整个时期
words.ex: He started his working life as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的职业生涯始于当老师。
words.en: The period of one's life spent in employment, typically from early adulthood to retirement.

words.tr: n. 建设性实践；有助于改进或发展的练习或做法
words.ex: He does constructive practice every day to improve his skills.
words.ex_cn: 他每天进行有建设性的练习来提高技能。
words.en: Practice that is helpful and intended to improve skills or understanding.

words.tr: n. 积极政策；正面政策（指政府或组织采取的主动、建设性的政策措施）
words.ex: The government made a positive policy to help poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府制定了一项有利于贫困家庭的积极政策。
words.en: A policy or action that has a beneficial effect or is intended to produce good results.

words.tr: n. 有帮助的方法；有益的途径
words.ex: This is a helpful approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种解决这个问题的有用方法。
words.en: A method or way of dealing with a situation that is useful and provides assistance.

words.tr: v. 保持灵活；保持弹性；保持适应性
words.ex: You should remain flexible when plans change.
words.ex_cn: 当计划改变时，你应该保持灵活。
words.en: To continue to be able to change or adapt easily according to new conditions.

words.tr: n. 意外的紧急情况和突发问题
words.ex: They faced unexpected emergencies and sudden issues last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚遇到了意外的紧急情况和突发问题。
words.en: Sudden and unplanned situations that require immediate attention or action.

words.tr: n. 意料之外的问题；未预见的困难
words.ex: They faced unforeseen problems during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在旅途中遇到了意想不到的问题。
words.en: Problems or difficulties that were not anticipated or expected to occur.

words.tr: phrase. 疾病；健康状况；医学病症
words.ex: Some people have medical conditions that need special care.
words.ex_cn: 有些人有需要特别照顾的医疗状况。
words.en: Medical conditions refer to the state of a person's health, especially when they are suffering from a particular illness or disease.

words.tr: phrase. 健康问题；身体或心理上的疾病或不适
words.ex: He has health problems because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多垃圾食品而有健康问题。
words.en: Issues or conditions that affect the physical or mental well-being of an individual.

words.tr: n. （身体或精神上的）疾病；（某种）病；（身体或精神上的）疾病( illness的名词复数 )；
words.ex: Children often get illnesses in winter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子冬天经常得病。
words.en: Diseases or medical conditions that affect the body or mind, often causing symptoms and requiring treatment.

words.tr: phrase. 技术问题；技术故障
words.ex: The computer has technical problems.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑有技术问题。
words.en: Difficulties or faults related to technology, machinery, or equipment.

words.tr: n. 系统问题；系统故障
words.ex: The computer has system issues and won't start.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑有系统问题，无法启动。
words.en: Malfunctions or faults within a system, often causing it to operate incorrectly.

words.tr: n. 计算机错误；电脑故障
words.ex: The computer errors stopped after the update.
words.ex_cn: 更新后，电脑错误停止了。
words.en: Mistakes or faults in a computer system or software that prevent it from working correctly.

words.tr: n. 正当理由；有效原因
words.ex: He gave valid reasons for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了迟到的合理理由。
words.en: A reason or explanation that is based on fact, truth, or logical argument and is therefore acceptable.

words.tr: n. 可接受的原因；合理的缘由
words.ex: These are acceptable causes for missing the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 这些是缺席会议的可接受原因。
words.en: A cause or reason that is considered satisfactory and meets required standards or expectations.

words.tr: n. 合理的借口；正当的理由
words.ex: He gave reasonable excuses for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他为迟到提供了合理的借口。
words.en: An acceptable reason for failing to meet a requirement or obligation.

words.tr: n. 合理的扩展；合理的延伸
words.ex: The teacher gave reasonable extensions for the homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师给作业提供了合理的延期。
words.en: Acceptable additional time granted to complete a task or meet a deadline.

words.tr: phrase. 健康问题；健康方面的困扰或疾病
words.ex: He has health issues because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多垃圾食品而有健康问题。
words.en: Health issues refer to problems related to the condition of the body or mind, often requiring medical attention or affecting one's well-being.

words.tr: n. 医疗问题；健康方面的困扰
words.ex: He has medical troubles because of his old age.
words.ex_cn: 他因为年老而有健康问题。
words.en: Health-related difficulties or ailments affecting a person's ability to function.

words.tr: n. 疾病；
words.ex: He stayed home because of sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病待在家里。
words.en: A particular illness or disease.

words.tr: n. IT 故障；信息技术系统故障
words.ex: It failures make him learn slowly.
words.ex_cn: 它的失败让他慢慢学会。
words.en: Malfunctions or breakdowns in computer hardware or software.

words.tr: n. 系统故障；系统错误
words.ex: The system faults caused the computer to shut down.
words.ex_cn: 系统故障导致电脑关闭。
words.en: Failures or defects in a technical or mechanical system.

words.tr: n. 被放弃的扣除项；被豁免的扣减（通常指税务或费用方面的减免）
words.ex: The fees were deductions waived for students in need.
words.ex_cn: 对有需要的学生，费用减免了。
words.en: The cancellation of financial charges or reductions that would normally be applied.

words.tr: n. 迫切的问题；紧急的问题
words.ex: Clean water is a pressing problem in many villages.
words.ex_cn: 清洁用水是许多村庄的紧迫问题。
words.en: A problem that requires immediate attention or action.

words.tr: n. 紧急问题；亟待解决的事项
words.ex: The doctor said this is an urgent issue.
words.ex_cn: 医生说这是一个紧急问题。
words.en: A matter that demands swift resolution or response.

words.tr: phrase. 严峻的挑战；重大的考验
words.ex: Overcoming climate change is a serious challenge for the global community.
words.ex_cn: 应对气候变化是全球社会面临的一个严峻挑战。
words.en: A serious challenge refers to a significant or difficult task or problem that requires considerable effort to overcome.

words.tr: phrase. 气候变化
words.ex: Climate change is making the weather hotter.
words.ex_cn: 气候变化让天气变得更热。
words.en: A significant and lasting change in the Earth's climate, especially a change due to an increase in the average atmospheric temperature.

words.tr: phrase. 全球变暖
words.ex: Global warming is making the Earth hotter.
words.ex_cn: 全球变暖正在让地球变得更热。
words.en: Global warming refers to the long-term increase in Earth's average surface temperature due to human activities, primarily fossil fuel burning, which increases heat-trapping greenhouse gas levels in Earth's atmosphere.

words.tr: phrase. 气候危机，指由全球变暖和其他气候变化引发的严重环境问题
words.ex: The climate crisis is threatening the survival of many species.
words.ex_cn: 气候危机正在威胁许多物种的生存。
words.en: A situation in which the Earth's climate is changing in ways that are harmful to the environment and to human life.

words.tr: n. 严重威胁
words.ex: Pollution is a serious threat to animals.
words.ex_cn: 污染是对动物的严重威胁。
words.en: A significant and imminent risk or danger.

words.tr: n. 重大危险；主要危险
words.ex: Smoking is a major danger to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康是巨大危险。
words.en: A substantial and serious source of peril or harm.

words.tr: n. 严重风险；高度危险
words.ex: Smoking causes a severe risk to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有严重风险。
words.en: A serious danger or threat that could cause significant harm or loss.

words.tr: phrase. 人类生命；人的生活
words.ex: The value of human life is priceless.
words.ex_cn: 人命是无价的。
words.en: The existence of humans, especially considered from the perspective of its quality, duration, and the experiences that constitute it.

words.tr: n. 人民的安全；民众的安全
words.ex: The government protects people's safety.
words.ex_cn: 政府保护人民的安全。
words.en: The protection and well-being of individuals and communities from harm.

words.tr: n. 人类生存；人的存活
words.ex: Clean water is essential for human survival.
words.ex_cn: 干净的水对人类生存至关重要。
words.en: The state of being alive or existing as a human being.

words.tr: phrase. 不断上升的气温；持续升高的温度
words.ex: The rising temperatures make the days very hot.
words.ex_cn: 气温上升让天气变得非常热。
words.en: An increase in the average temperature of the atmosphere or a specific region.

words.tr: n. 不断增加的热量；持续升高的热度
words.ex: The increasing heat makes the water boil.
words.ex_cn: 不断升高的热量使水沸腾。
words.en: A gradual rise in temperature, often linked to global warming trends.

words.tr: phrase. 自然灾害；天灾
words.ex: Natural disasters can destroy homes and villages.
words.ex_cn: 自然灾害会摧毁房屋和村庄。
words.en: Natural disasters are major adverse events resulting from natural processes of the Earth; examples include floods, hurricanes, tornadoes, volcanic eruptions, earthquakes, tsunamis, and other geologic processes.

words.tr: n. 环境危机（指对自然环境造成严重威胁或破坏的紧急状况）
words.ex: The world faces many environmental crises now.
words.ex_cn: 现在世界面临许多环境危机。
words.en: Urgent problems related to the natural world that threaten ecosystems and human life.

words.tr: n. 气候灾难；气候引起的严重灾害
words.ex: Climate catastrophes destroy homes and farms.
words.ex_cn: 气候灾难摧毁了家园和农田。
words.en: Extreme, large-scale environmental disasters with devastating consequences.

words.tr: n. 洪水和野火（指自然灾害中的两种常见类型）
words.ex: Floods and wildfires destroy homes every year.
words.ex_cn: 洪水和野火每年都会摧毁家园。
words.en: Natural disasters involving excessive water overflow and uncontrolled fires.

words.tr: n. 暴风雨和丛林大火（指自然灾害中的风暴与野火）
words.ex: Storms and bushfires destroyed many homes last summer.
words.ex_cn: 风暴和丛林大火在去年夏天摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: Severe weather events and intense, fast-spreading fires in vegetation.

words.tr: n. 洪水和火灾
words.ex: The storm caused flooding and fires in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴导致了城市里的洪水和火灾。
words.en: The occurrence of overflow of water onto land and the outbreak of uncontrolled fires.

words.tr: v. 危及公民；使市民处于危险之中
words.ex: The storm may endanger citizens.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴可能危及市民。
words.en: To place citizens in a situation of potential harm or danger.

words.tr: v. 使人们处于危险之中；危及人们的安全
words.ex: Smoking puts people at risk of lung cancer.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟使人们面临患肺癌的风险。
words.en: To expose individuals to the possibility of injury, damage, or loss.

words.tr: v. 伤害居民；对居民造成损害
words.ex: The factory harms residents nearby.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂伤害了附近的居民。
words.en: Cause damage or distress to people living in a particular area.

words.tr: 他们的性质；他们的属性
words.ex: The balls have their properties listed on the box.
words.ex_cn: 这些球的特性列在盒子上。
words.en: The possessions and assets owned by a specific group of people.

words.tr: 他们的家

words.tr: n. 沿海人口；居住在沿海地区的人群

words.tr: n. 滨海社区；沿岸居民区

words.tr: n. 海滨居民；住在海边的人

words.ex: The coral reefs are affected by climate change.

words.en: Practical and successful methods for solving problems or achieving goals.

words.tr: n. 有用的措施；有益的手段

words.tr: n. 生态税；环保税（指为减少环境污染和促进可持续发展而征收的税项）

words.ex_cn: 政府引入了环保税以减少污染。
words.en: Taxes designed to reduce environmental damage by making polluting activities more expensive.

words.tr: phrase. 减少碳排放；降低二氧化碳排放量

words.tr: v. 减少温室气体排放

words.en: Reduce the amount of gases like carbon dioxide released into the atmosphere.

words.tr: phrase. 根本原因

words.en: The fundamental reason behind a problem or issue, which, if resolved, would prevent the problem from occurring.

words.tr: phrase. 主要原因

words.ex_cn: 延迟的主要原因是恶劣的天气。
words.en: The primary cause or explanation for something.

words.tr: n. 核心因素；关键要素

words.ex_cn: 成功的核心因素是努力工作。
words.en: A central or essential element that plays a decisive role in a situation.

words.tr: n. 严格的措施；严厉的手段
words.ex: The government took strict measures to stop the virus.
words.ex_cn: 政府采取了严格的措施来阻止病毒。
words.en: Firm and uncompromising actions taken to enforce rules or standards.

words.tr: n. 强硬政策；严厉措施

words.en: Forceful and determined policies intended to achieve specific outcomes.

words.tr: n. 严格的法规；强有力的监管措施
words.ex: The government has strong regulations about pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府对污染有严格的法规。
words.en: Stringent and powerful rules and guidelines that must be followed.

words.tr: phrase. 规范行为
words.ex: Rules help to regulate behaviour in school.
words.ex_cn: 规则有助于规范学校里的行为。
words.en: To control or direct something, especially behaviour, by means of rules or laws.

words.tr: n. 控制动作；控制措施
words.ex: The teacher gives control actions to manage the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师采取管理措施来维持课堂秩序。
words.en: Actions taken to manage or regulate processes, especially in environmental or business contexts.

words.w: minimise greenhouse gas reduce air pollution
words.tr: v. 减少温室气体，降低空气污染

words.ex_cn: 我们必须减少温室气体以降低空气污染。
words.en: To reduce the emission of gases that trap heat in the atmosphere and improve air quality.

words.tr: n. 碳排放量；碳输出
words.ex: The factory reduces carbon output every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每年减少碳排放。
words.en: The amount of carbon dioxide and other carbon compounds released into the environment, often from burning fossil fuels.

words.tr: phrase. 碳足迹；指个人、组织、活动或产品直接和间接产生的温室气体排放总量

words.ex_cn: 他通过步行上班来减少自己的碳足迹。
words.en: The amount of carbon dioxide and other carbon compounds emitted due to the consumption of fossil fuels by a particular person, group, etc.

words.tr: n. 税收的实施；税制的执行

words.ex_cn: 政府去年开始实施税收。
words.en: The process of putting into effect a system of charges levied by a government, typically to discourage harmful activities.

words.w: balance between work and life worklife balance

words.ex_cn: 她努力保持工作与生活的平衡。
words.en: The state of equilibrium where a person equally divides their time and energy between their career and personal life.

words.tr: phrase. 毕生事业的和谐；一生工作的协调统一

words.ex_cn: 他一生致力于创作艺术，以追求事业与生活的和谐。
words.en: A lifestyle where professional duties and personal interests are integrated harmoniously, avoiding strict separation.

words.en: The condition of being free from illness or injury, encompassing both physical vitality and psychological stability.

words.tr: 员工需要时间

words.tr: 工人需要工时

words.ex_cn: 工人需要时间来完成这项工作。
words.en: The necessity for workers to have a specific number of hours dedicated to work, often within legal or contractual limits.

words.tr: 员工需要时间
words.ex: The staff require time to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 员工需要时间来完成这个项目。
words.en: The need for staff to be allocated sufficient time for their tasks, ensuring productivity without overwork.

words.tr: phrase. 保持精力充沛；维持活力
words.ex: She drinks water and sleeps well to stay energetic.
words.ex_cn: 她喝水并好好睡觉以保持精力充沛。
words.en: Maintain a high level of physical or mental activity and enthusiasm.

words.tr: phrase. 保持活跃；保持活动状态；持续参与
words.ex: He keeps active by walking every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上散步来保持活跃。
words.en: To continue to be physically or mentally active.

words.tr: phrase. 保持活跃；继续充满活力
words.ex: The children remain lively after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们午饭后仍然很活泼。
words.en: To continue to be full of energy, activity, or interest; to stay vibrant and animated.

words.tr: 提高工作效率，提升生产力
words.ex: He is improving work efficiency by boosting productivity.
words.ex_cn: 他通过提高生产力来提升工作效率。
words.en: The process of making work more effective and productive, often by optimizing time, resources, and methods to achieve better results with less effort.

words.tr: 提升性能；增强表现
words.ex: He is enhancing performance by practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天练习来提高表现。
words.en: Improving the efficiency, effectiveness, or quality of a task, process, or system.

words.tr: 短语。与家人共度时光

words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末和家人共度时光。
words.en: The act of dedicating time to engage in activities or share experiences with one's family members, fostering relationships and creating memories.

words.tr: phrase. 与所爱之人在一起（的状态或经历）

words.ex_cn: 她和亲人在一起时感到快乐。
words.en: Spending time in the company of family members, partners, or friends to foster emotional bonds.

words.tr: phrase. 享受家庭时光
words.ex: They are enjoying family time at the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在公园里享受家庭时光。
words.en: Spending quality time with family members, typically in a relaxed and happy manner.

words.tr: phrase. 释放压力；缓解压力
words.ex: She listens to music to release stress.
words.ex_cn: 她听音乐来释放压力。
words.en: To release stress means to free oneself from the pressures and tensions that accumulate in daily life, often through activities or practices that promote relaxation and well-being.

words.tr: phrase. 缓解紧张；减轻压力；缓和局势
words.ex: Deep breathing exercises can help reduce tension.
words.ex_cn: 深呼吸练习有助于消除紧张。
words.en: To lessen feelings of stress, anxiety, or conflict between people.

words.tr: phrase. 缓解压力；减轻压力；解除压迫
words.ex: Taking a walk can help to relieve pressure after a long day at work.
words.ex_cn: 工作一天后散步有助于缓解压力。
words.en: To relieve pressure means to lessen the physical or mental stress or tension.

words.w: strengthen emotional bonds build closer ties

words.ex: They spend time together to strengthen emotional bonds and build closer ties.
words.ex_cn: 他们花时间在一起，以加强情感联系，建立更紧密的关系。
words.en: To deepen and reinforce the emotional connections between people, fostering a sense of intimacy and mutual support.

words.tr: phrase. 加深关系；使关系更加紧密或亲密
words.ex: They talk every day to deepen relationships.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天聊天以加深关系。
words.en: To make connections with others more profound, meaningful, and emotionally close through increased understanding, trust, and shared experiences.

words.tr: phrase. 感到有压力的；感到紧张的

words.ex_cn: 当我有太多作业时，我感到压力很大。
words.en: To experience mental or emotional pressure or worry.

words.tr: phrase. 感到有压力；感觉被逼迫
words.ex: He feels pressured to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有压力要完成作业。
words.en: To feel forced or stressed by expectations.

words.tr: 感到筋疲力尽的；感到耗尽精力的

words.ex_cn: 我跑30分钟后感到筋疲力尽。
words.en: To feel exhausted means to feel extremely tired or drained of energy.

words.tr: phrase. 身体活动不足；缺乏足够的体力活动

words.ex_cn: 他每天的体力活动不足。
words.en: Not enough physical movement or exercise to maintain good health, often leading to health risks.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏运动；缺少锻炼

words.ex_cn: 医生警告他缺乏运动的危险。
words.en: An insufficient amount of physical activity, which can lead to various health issues including obesity, cardiovascular disease, and weakened muscles.

words.ex_cn: 他感到悲伤，因为他缺乏情感支持和家人的关爱。
words.en: Absence of emotional care and support from others.

words.tr: phrase. 没有鼓励；缺乏鼓舞
words.ex: He did his homework with no encouragement from his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他做作业时没有得到父母的鼓励。
words.en: Absence of motivation or positive reinforcement.

words.tr: phrase. 经济负担；财政压力
words.ex: The family faced financial burdens after losing their job.
words.ex_cn: 这家人在失去工作后面临经济负担。
words.en: Financial burdens refer to the financial obligations or pressures that weigh on an individual or organization, often causing stress or limiting the ability to spend on other necessities or desires.

words.tr: phrase. 经济压力；指由于财政困难、通货膨胀、失业或收入减少等原因造成的财务负担或紧张状况
words.ex: The family feels economic pressure because of high rent.
words.ex_cn: 由于房租高昂，这个家庭感到经济压力。
words.en: The stress or strain caused by financial concerns or the need to manage limited monetary resources.

words.tr: phrase. 金钱压力；因财务问题而产生的焦虑或紧张情绪
words.ex: He feels money stress every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都感到经济压力。
words.en: Financial strain caused by insufficient funds.

words.tr: phrase. 出租或购买房屋

words.tr: 购买或租赁房屋

words.ex_cn: 他们可以在公园附近买房或租房。
words.en: Obtaining housing through purchase or rental agreements.

words.en: Urban areas with high population density and extensive infrastructure.

words.tr: phrase. 大城镇；大城市（复数）

words.en: Significant urban settlements with considerable populations.

words.tr: phrase. 城市地区

words.ex_cn: 许多人住在城市地区。

words.tr: phrase. 定居；平静下来；专心于

words.ex_cn: 他想安定下来组建家庭。
words.en: To settle down means to start living in a place where you intend to stay for a long time, usually after moving around a lot.

words.tr: phrase. 建立一种生活；构建自己的人生
words.ex: He wants to build a life with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他想和家人一起建立生活。
words.en: Establishing a stable and fulfilling personal existence.

words.tr: phrase. 安家；建立家庭；营造家庭氛围
words.ex: They want to make a home in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他们想在乡下安家。
words.en: Creating a comfortable and secure living environment.

words.tr: phrase. 年轻员工；资历较浅的雇员
words.ex: Younger employees often use new technology at work.
words.ex_cn: 年轻员工经常在工作中使用新技术。
words.en: Individuals in the early stages of their professional careers.

words.tr: phrase. 年轻的工人；青年劳动者
words.ex: Young workers are learning new skills at the factory.
words.ex_cn: 年轻工人们正在工厂里学习新技能。
words.en: Employees who are in the early stages of their careers.

words.tr: phrase. 初级职员；基层员工
words.ex: The junior staff helped with the paperwork.
words.ex_cn: 初级员工帮忙处理了文件。
words.en: Employees with the least experience or lowest rank in an organization's hierarchy.

words.tr: phrase. 财政困难

words.ex_cn: 他失业后遇到了经济困难。
words.en: Financial difficulties refer to the problems or challenges faced by individuals, families, or organizations in managing their money or resources, often leading to the inability to meet financial obligations or achieve financial goals.

words.tr: phrase. 资金问题；金钱问题
words.ex: He lost his job and now has money problems.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了工作，现在有资金问题。
words.en: Financial difficulties or issues that affect an individual's or organization's ability to manage their finances effectively.

words.tr: phrase. 经济困难；经济困境
words.ex: Many families face economic hardship during the recession.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭在经济衰退期间面临经济困难。
words.en: Economic hardship refers to a condition where individuals or communities face financial difficulties, often leading to a reduced standard of living.

words.tr: phrase. 加班；超时工作
words.ex: He works overtime to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他加班赚更多钱。
words.en: To work beyond the regular working hours, often to complete tasks or meet deadlines.

words.tr: phrase. 加班；做额外的工作时间
words.ex: He does extra hours to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他加班赚更多的钱。
words.en: Work beyond regular hours, often for extra pay.

words.tr: phrase. 延长工作时间
words.ex: The company will extend working time to meet the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 公司将会延长工作时间以赶上截止日期。
words.en: Lengthen the duration of work, typically beyond scheduled hours.

words.tr: phrase. 赚取额外收入
